briefs.topic: Meta Muse Code multi-agent coding launch
briefs.freshness: 2026-08-05, still active in August AI-agent conversation
briefs.signal: Meta's Muse Code is part of the current wave of coding agents that fan tasks out to parallel sub-agents, making 'one specialist tool versus a broader multi-agent workbench' a timely product-category joke.

mapping.comparison_role: 很能打但只守一个擂台的高手
mapping.product_role: 把写作、研究、review、修改和 coding 一起调度的总指挥

panels.scene: 原创竞技场，一个代码高手正在飞快敲键盘，观众欢呼。不要出现 Meta logo 或 Muse Code UI。

panels.scene: 场外同时送来 PRD、长文、研究资料、review 和代码五类任务，代码高手开始顾不过来。
